notes: 'afore' is kept inside προεπηγγείλατο's unit as the realization of the προ- preverb, headed on the lexical verb (rule 106); it is correctly not marked added.
τῶν is unrepresented because αὐτοῦ carries the possessive (rule 20), and the supplied 'the' of 'the holy scriptures' belongs to the anarthrous noun rather than the attributive adjective (rule 58).
